about: the same book, with clear_all_crosses read: a while loop over try_match, each pass taking the best bid and the best ask (max and min by a key) while they cross

lines: # gdp: law the book no longer crosses: forall b in self.bids: forall a in self.asks: b.price < a.price

# gdp: law the best bids fill first: forall o in old(self.bids): forall j in old(self.bids): o in self.bids or j not in self.bids or o.price > j.price or (o.price == j.price and o.timestamp <= j.timestamp)
